statement: The function returns Ok v for some vector v, and v is exactly the strictly increasing array of all integers that occur in all three arrays. Formally: (1) for every integer x, x occurs in v (there exists i with 0 <= i < len(v) and v[i] = x) if and only if x occurs in arr1, x occurs in arr2, and x occurs in arr3, where x occurs in an array arr means there exists j with 0 <= j < len(arr) and arr[j] = x; and (2) for every i with 0 <= i < len(v)-1, v[i] < v[i+1].
preconditions: arr1, arr2, arr3 are 0-indexed arrays; len(arr1), len(arr2), len(arr3) are each between 1 and 1000 inclusive; every element of arr1, arr2, arr3 is an integer between 1 and 2000 inclusive; and each of arr1, arr2, arr3 is strictly increasing (for each t in {1,2,3} and every i with 0 <= i < len(arrt)-1, arrt[i] < arrt[i+1]).

statement: The function returns Ok v for some vector v; in particular, it does not return a failure.

statement: Whenever the function returns Ok v, for every index i with 0 <= i < len(v), the value v[i] occurs in arr1, occurs in arr2, and occurs in arr3, where x occurs in an array arr means there exists j with 0 <= j < len(arr) and arr[j] = x.
